answer: Require several vertex-disjoint trust paths from the honest seed core, not mere connectedness. By Menger's theorem the count of independent paths reaching an identity equals the min cut to the seeds — and a sybil lagoon, however densely its members wire themselves, reaches the core by only the few real bridges its operator earned. Internal edges add no disjoint path; they just recycle trust among fakes like a glacier grinding in place. So one bridge caps a whole farm's weight no matter how many personas crowd behind it.
